profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - LLM Agent Data Optimization
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I use AI agents in my day-to-day life. I'm constantly finding new ways to leverage AI agents from planning a trip, exploring personal curiosities, automating parts of my life, and agentic coding. I'm especially curious in the blindspots, for example, how smarter dev infrastructure can fundamentally change how software gets written and validated. I have been a champion for bazel build for large scale projects.

I'm currently at Meta, working on Android performance and reliability for Facebook Messenger on mobile. I love the working cross functionally and on solving problems that limit adoption of our product.
 
Previously at Google, I was a tech-lead for a team working on GCP Console UI for Data Analytics, owning frontend architecture and working on cross-functional initiatives with product and design. Our team also accelerated our accessibility compliance efforts in order to unblock key enterprise customers and help leadership to meet critical commitments.
 
Before that at Microsoft, I started from zero to rebuild the Visual Studio Installer UI. I drove cross-team collaboration across engineering and product to ship WinJS, an app framework for Windows. I also built data pipelines that measured feature health across Windows, often collaborating with DS and PM.
 
I studied computer science at The Ohio State University, where as an undergrad I was lucky to contribute to research on novel search algorithms for using MapReduce and relevance clustering.
 
Outside of work, I run my personal OpenClaw and enjoy travel. Ohio -> Seattle -> NYC
